name: vfx-shatter
title: Glass Shatter
description: A glass shatter transition: a cracked-glass shader spreads from the centre of the first page, then 200 Voronoi shards break loose, fall with gravity and bounce while the second page is revealed behind them. WebGL over two built-in pages.
useWhen: A dramatic cut where the screen breaks like glass and falls away to reveal the next scene.
Launch and announcement videos that need an impact moment.
avoidWhen: You need to shatter your own scenes: the block plays between its two built-in pages; copy the shader and shard code and feed it your own frames.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)
